instruction.name: xvreplve.b
instruction.description: Replicate a b element of xj using a GPR index.

latencies.notes: Latency from the index register to the vector destination, measured as a round trip through xvpickve2gr.d (7.88 cycles) with the 5-cycle pick subtracted, which leaves 3. A chain that only depends on vd measures 1 cycle because the self-dependency is renamed away.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvreplve.b $xr0, $xr8, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr1, $xr9, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr2, $xr10, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr3, $xr11, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr4, $xr12, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr5, $xr13, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr6, $xr14, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr7, $xr15, $r5
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr1, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4' --asm 'xvreplve.b $xr0, $xr8, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr1, $xr9, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr2, $xr10, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr3, $xr11, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr4, $xr12, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr5, $xr13, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr6, $xr14, $r5; xvreplve.b $xr7, $xr15, $r5'
